name: legitimate-substack-newsletter
description: False-positive regression, observed in production: an independent newsletter sent from a platform domain, where every outbound link is rewritten to the platform's own redirector while the anchor text still reads as the destination site. Before the onSenderDomain guard this produced several 'high' displayed-vs-actual mismatches, maxed the link category, and floored the message at 50/100 'Suspicious'. Anchor text naming third-party sites is the whole point of a link roundup and must not be read as deception. Publication, author and linked sites are invented; the platform, link shapes and authentication are as observed.

email.subject: The Brew Notes: Become An Alpha
email.bodyText:
Hey Folks,

Yes we're aware, this newsletter should have gone out 2 weeks ago, but we're going to pretend like we didn't just skip an entire edition. Anyhoo, onto the coffee (and non-coffee) stuff!

The Alpha dripper

The new Alpha dripper landed this month and it is a genuinely odd little brewer. Thicker glass, a flatter bed, and a price that undercuts last year's model by a fair margin. We brewed on it every morning for two weeks and came away liking it more than we expected.

Elsewhere: northwind-roastery.com ran a good piece on green coffee pricing, northwind-harvest.org has a readable explainer on the new harvest forecasts, and our friends at northwind-coffee.co.uk opened subscriptions again.
